name: Rocky Mountain National Park – Bear Lake Corridor
agency: NPS Rocky Mountain GIS, USGS 3DEP & OpenStreetMap Contributors
summary: High-altitude glacial gorges, alpine cirque lakes, and Continental Divide tundra climbs between 9,475 ft and 12,324 ft.

trails.name: Bear, Nymph, Dream & Emerald Lakes Trail
trails.condition_note: Classic subalpine four-lake walk beneath Hallett Peak.
trails.description: Strings together four subalpine glacial lakes culminating at Emerald Lake (10,110 ft) directly beneath the sheer cirque walls of Hallett Peak and Flattop Mountain.

trails.name: Glacier Gorge toThe Loch & Sky Pond
trails.condition_note: Short wet rock scramble beside Timberline Falls; snow patches linger in cirque.
trails.description: Climbs past Alberta Falls and The Loch before scrambling alongside Timberline Falls into the dramatic alpine cathedral of Sky Pond (10,900 ft) and the Sharkstooth.

trails.name: Flattop Mountain & Continental Divide Trail
trails.condition_note: High-altitude tundra above 11,500 ft; afternoon lightning risk.
trails.description: Ascends continuously from Bear Lake above treeline onto the Continental Divide at Flattop Mountain (12,324 ft).
